root.label: DOJ poll monitoring in Laramie County during Wyoming primary

events.label: DOJ poll monitoring in Laramie County during Wyoming primary

slots.name: monitor arrival time
slots.sentence: The monitors arrived soon after polls opened at 7 a.m. on primary day and said they intended to interview voters while assessing compliance with federal civil rights and voting rights laws, Laramie County Clerk Debra Lee said in a statement.
